title: An Act Regarding Liability for Acts of Violence Occurring in the State House or Legislative Space in the Burton M. Cross Building

summary.text: This bill provides that the Legislature is liable for bodily injury to or death of a Legislator that results from an act of violence occurring in the State House or legislative space in the Burton M. Cross Building.
